decisions.evidence: Reviewed every step and F1/F2 against the current absolute Hodge package and homogeneous nilpotent-string construction. Hypotheses (a)-(c) suffice: the polynomial maximal-minor Plucker limit exists even for d=0; ker L^j lies in W_(j-1); the homogeneous-string lifting in 3.1 realizes all graded primitive tests. Pairing degrees in q_i total 2n. Rank adjointness proves D=Lambda orthogonal-direct-sum M; strings give radical D intersect W_-1. Hodge-stable semipositivity and quotient nondegeneracy yield the stated polarization without assuming middle positivity. Checked n=0, L=0, zero graded pieces and length-one strings. DCM section 5.4, Lemmas 5.4.1-5.4.4 and endpoint proof, printed pp.48-51, independently read. Reader/refuter finding arrays are empty. Item bytes unchanged between pre/post snapshots; only citation/derivation and boundary contract enrichment was routed.

Every numbered step and current recollement/six-operation supplier proof reviewed. In 2.1 the positive truncation C lies in >=1 and C[-1] in >=2, giving both Hom vanishings; the dual truncation proves the largest supported quotient. In 3.1 the inverse of ba produces a retraction and both boundary exclusions. In 4.1 the counit for Rj_! and unit for Rj_* have the correct directions; heart adjunction fixes the comparison by its restriction. Step 5.1 recovers the identity on the supported summand. Checked Z empty, U empty, P=0, P=i_*T and P=j_!*Q; no projective-image invertibility is inferred. DCM Lemma 4.1.3 with Assumption 4.1.1 and full proof, printed pp.29-31, read; the carrier proves a general heart-level criterion rather than importing its stratum dimension hypothesis. Reader corrected a false truncation-orthogonality description and reversed unit/counit names; the current proof soundly resolves both, with unchanged Statement.

Reviewed all nine main steps, full constructions A-H, every declared supplier Statement, and the relevant ordinary six-operation/recollement, universal-hyperplane and Hodge-substructure proofs. A fixes the positive Thom counit and all R/G shifts; target tensor naturality kills the parameter perverse-degree action. B-C use genuine generic transverse cuts and lower defect only while positive; maximal pullback quotient proves the middle eta isomorphism. D proves the first target power using an actual L-kernel/Hodge-type lift before declaring the perverse filtration Hodge. E checks W_a H^q=F_(q-n+a), every hypothesis (a)-(c), semipositive pullback plus epsilon positive source Kähler form, graded primitive lifts, orthogonal finite eta/L strings and (-1)^(r+s) transport. F uses strict filtered natural maps, actual proper-fibre image equality and a pure projector-stable class image; raw cup nondegeneracy follows on each polarized block, not on arbitrary subspaces of full cohomology. G constructs constrained smooth target slices and cancels both real normal shifts; intermediate extension needs only finite sums. H constructs a good rational generic section in a product-projective fibre; graph pullback has net shift (d-s)+s-d=0, and lower graded restriction gives the genuine Gauss-Manin quotient. Checked r=0, m=0, zero/empty fibres and grades, j>m, point/top/intermediate strata, disconnected slices and complexification. Independently read DCM sections 4.3-4.7 and 5-6, printed pp.33-59 (plus splitting criterion pp.29-31); no circular middle semisimplicity or primitive-compatible global lift is used. Reader corrections are sound; Statement and manifest unchanged. Alpha refreshed two F5 contract quotes against current batch-42 Statements: the restriction-image locator now explicitly identifies arXiv v1 Proposition 8.3.2, and the class-map quote now has the literal LaTeX times command rather than a tab escape. These are citation-record synchronization only; Construction F still meets smooth quasiprojective U-prime, proper Z and pure-dimensional smooth projective X hypotheses. No mathematical carrier changed.

Both numbered steps, Facts F1-F3 and all seven supplier interfaces checked against current proofs reviewed earlier and the ample-powers Statement. Finite smooth connected components are irreducible and have common dimension n; their projective reduced images give exact closed pushforward. Lexicographic (r,m) order on nonnegative integers is well-founded despite lower-defect families having larger source/target dimensions; the full stronger induction package is assumed and discharged, not just the theorem subset. The point-image base has absolute eta Lefschetz, finite splitting and semisimple point coefficients. Choosing a high very ample power gives eta_0=m eta and eta^i=m^(-i) eta_0^i over Q; splitting/IC semisimplicity are unaffected. Checked empty X, finite point image, r=0, eta power i=0 and vanishing degrees. The exact central induction supplies rational and complexified IC semisimplicity without a nonprojective-source reduction. Reader changed only contract citations/derivations; item pre/post hashes agree. No carrier defect found.

Both proof steps and all six declared supplier interfaces checked, including the full scalar-extension lemma and the ordinary argument in contextual equivariant supplier step 2.1. Field extension is exact, preserves upper support bounds, commutes with ordinary duality and thus preserves lower bounds; uniqueness of t-truncations and exact heart images give IC compatibility. The rational theorem supplies complexified semisimplicity. The monodromy algebra is finite-dimensional and faithful after complexification; radical nilpotence gives semisimplicity of that algebra, and the nonzero rational regular-trace determinant remains nonzero over every characteristic-zero field, eliminating the extended radical. Thus no embedding k into C or preservation of rational simplicity is assumed. Finite decompositions into simple k-local systems give simple ICs. Checked k=Q, k=C, fields without complex embeddings, zero local systems and empty source. Reader replaced the old unqualified equivariant import in F3 with the correct ordinary derivation and confined the equivariant reference to Remarks. The Statement and manifest are unchanged; repair is complete.

Both verification steps and all four supplier interfaces checked. The explicit closed-ball map w -> [w:sqrt(1-||w||^2)] is well-defined on its boundary (w nonzero), takes the interior homeomorphically to C^j via w/sqrt(1-||w||^2), and attaches one real 2j-cell along projective (j-1)-space. Cellular cochains with constant k have adjacent odd groups zero, so all differentials vanish. On the sole point stratum support/cosupport impose ordinary <=0/>=0 bounds, not vacuous bounds. H^i(Rf_*k[n])=H^(n+i)(P^n;k) yields precisely degrees -n,-n+2,...,n and summands k[n-2j]. Checked n=0, n=1 and both degree endpoints; empty source is outside this example. Hatcher Example 0.6, printed pp.6-7, read completely; the calculation also has a proved cellular supplier. Reader corrected the false point-stratum vacuity assertion and added exact F1-F3 tags; mathematics and Statement preserved.
